model.title: Pacific POWER Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Brian Schatz (D-HI)

summary.text: The bill would promote the development and use of geothermal energy resources in the Pacific region. It aims to support geothermal projects and infrastructure in Pacific areas to advance clean energy production.
